Job_Description":" Backend Engineer





Location: Noida (Hybrid/Onsite), Uttar Pradesh, India

Experience: 5+ Years

Employment Type: Full-Time



About Netision Technology LLP


Netision Technology LLP is a leading technology consulting and software development company delivering innovative digital solutions to clients across the USA, UAE, UK, and India. We specialize in Web & Mobile Application Development, AI/ML Solutions, Cloud Computing, Enterprise Software, DevOps, Data Engineering, and Digital Transformation. Our mission is to help businesses accelerate growth through scalable, secure, and modern technology solutions.


We are looking for an experienced Backend Engineer who is passionate about building high-performance backend systems, designing scalable APIs, and delivering enterprise-grade applications.




Requirements Job Summary


Netision Technology LLP is seeking a Backend Engineer with 5 + years of experience in designing, developing, and maintaining secure, scalable, and high-performance backend applications. The ideal candidate should have strong expertise in Python and Node.js , RESTful API development, PostgreSQL, Microsoft Azure cloud services, and CI/CD automation.



Key Responsibilities

Design, develop, and maintain scalable backend applications using Python (FastAPI, Flask, or Django) and Node.js .

Build secure, high-performance RESTful APIs and microservices.

Design, optimize, and maintain PostgreSQL databases, including schema design, indexing, query optimization, and performance tuning.

Integrate backend services with frontend applications and third-party APIs.

Implement secure authentication and authorization mechanisms using industry best practices.

Optimize application performance, scalability, and reliability for production environments.

Troubleshoot, debug, and resolve production issues efficiently.

Deploy and maintain applications on Microsoft Azure App Services and other Azure services.

Implement CI/CD pipelines using GitHub and GitHub Actions .

Participate in code reviews and ensure adherence to coding standards and best practices.

Collaborate with frontend developers, QA engineers, DevOps teams, and project managers.

Work within Agile/Scrum teams and contribute to sprint planning, estimation, and continuous improvement.




Preferred Skills

Experience with Docker and Kubernetes .

Exposure to Azure DevOps or similar CI/CD platforms.

Knowledge of Redis for caching.

Experience with message brokers such as RabbitMQ , Kafka , or Azure Service Bus .

Familiarity with MongoDB or other NoSQL databases.

Experience working on enterprise-scale applications.

Knowledge of automated testing frameworks and API testing tools.

Experience mentoring junior developers and conducting technical code reviews.







Benefits Why Join Netision Technology LLP

Work on cutting-edge technologies including AI, Cloud, DevOps, and Enterprise Applications.

Opportunity to collaborate with global clients across multiple industries.

Continuous learning, certifications, and career development opportunities.

Competitive salary and performance-based incentives.

Flexible and collaborative work culture.

Opportunity to work on challenging, large-scale digital transformation projects.

Supportive environment that encourages innovation, ownership, and professional growth.
